name: campus-net-monitor
description: 校园网质量深度监控 - TypeScript 重构版

scripts.dev: concurrently -n engine,gui -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @campus-net/engine" "next dev -p 3002 --dir packages/gui"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @campus-net/engine && npm run build -w @campus-net/gui
scripts.start: concurrently -n engine,gui -c blue,green "npm run start -w @campus-net/engine" "next start -p 3002 --dir packages/gui"
